# B2 vocabulary batch 96

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `knowingly`, `laborer`, `lame`, `lance`, `landing`,
`landlady`, `laser`, `last-minute`, `lastly`, `lava`, `lawmaker`, `lawsuit`, `layabout`,
`legendary`, `legislate`, `legislator`, `legislature`, `legitimate`, `leisurely`, `lengthen`,
`leopard`, `lid`, `lifeless`, `lighten`, and `lighting`.

The entries were checked individually for sense, American IPA, level, controlled topics, natural
Vietnamese glosses, and original example pairs. The five IPA affricates were corrected to the
project's accepted `dʒ`/`tʃ` notation before final generation.
